title: LRU Cache
signature: class LRUCache: def __init__(self, capacity: int) -> None; def get(self, key: int) -> int; def put(self, key: int, value: int) -> None
docstring: Design a least-recently-used cache. get(key) returns the value or -1. put(key, value) inserts or updates; if capacity is exceeded, evict the least recently used key. Both operations must be O(1) average time.
constraints: At most 2 * 10^5 calls to get and put
